intro: The Meraki corner table is here to make every inch of your space more beautiful and useful. With its warm finish and clever design, it’s the perfect blend of style and practicality.

features.title: A touch of warmth for your home
features.text: The rich brown finish exudes sophistication, effortlessly blending with various décor styles while adding a warm, welcoming vibe to your room.

features.title: Smart storage, always within reach
features.text: Built from high-quality engineered wood, the table ensures longevity and strength, making it a reliable choice for everyday use.

features.title: Lightweight and effortlessly mobile
features.text: Move it around effortlessly! Its lightweight build ensures you can adjust your living space layout with ease and convenience.

features.title: Small Space, Big Impact
features.text: A sleek design that fits seamlessly into smaller spaces, maximizing functionality without compromising on style.

features.title: Easy assembly, zero hassle
features.text: Set it up in no time with its simple knockdown construction, perfect for hassle-free assembly and transport.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
